improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
improve.coach: 60% of your last five, up from 45% overall. Time to put this one front and center.

improve.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.
Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.
improve.coach: Steady at about 30% of matches. Steady means fixable; it's a habit, not a fluke.

improve.title: Tackle timing
tips: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Win it with your body before your foot: shoulder to shoulder, then poke it away.
improve.coach: 30% of matches, right in line with your recent form. A good one to drill.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: The goal was open and you walked right through the door. 45% of the time. Rock solid.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Your passes had GPS and good manners. 40% of the time. A real weapon.
